# viettelcloud_security_group (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud security group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic security group
resource "viettelcloud_security_group" "example" {
  name        = "my-security-group"
  region      = { name = "vn-central-1" }
  description = "Example security group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the security group.
- `region` (Attributes) Project region where the security group is created. Changing it replaces the security group because the update operation cannot move one between regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--region))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the security group. Omitting it preserves the backend value; set it to an empty string to clear it. A security group created without a description reports an empty string rather than a null value.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the security group was created (RFC3339).
- `display_name` (String) Display name assigned by the backend.
- `id` (String) Security group ID (UUID).
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the project's default security group.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID) that owns the security group.
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID) that owns the security group.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the security group was last updated (RFC3339).

<a id="nestedatt--region"></a>
### Nested Schema for `region`

Required:

- `name` (String) Region name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a security group by ID.
terraform import viettelcloud_security_group.example 6f1a2c3d-4e5b-6789-abcd-ef0123456789
```
